name: hopeboard
description: Teaches ordinary people how to read a stock price.

scripts.build: npm test && vite build && tsx scripts/prerender.ts
scripts.refresh:install: sed "s|__HOPEBOARD__|$PWD|" scripts/com.hopeboard.refresh.plist > ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.hopeboard.refresh.plist && launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.hopeboard.refresh 2>/dev/null; launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.hopeboard.refresh.plist
